content.comment_body: I installed [product_name] [version_no] on my computer (i5 8GB / Windows 10 Pro 64-bit / Java Runtime v8u201) as an administrator. When I try to start the application, I briefly see the loading screen, and then the window opens but closes almost instantly. The same issue occurs whether running as admin, logged in as admin, with security software disabled, or after multiple reinstalls. I haven't found similar cases on this forum. Does anyone have any suggestions?
Hi, I'm using a similar operating system and PC (i5, Windows 10, 8GB), and [product_name] [version_no] runs without issues for me. Have you tried launching it in compatibility mode?
Hello [user_name], check if you have created a God Mode folder. If so, delete it.

As mentioned earlier, having 'God Mode' active can interfere with how Java applications work. Also, ensure everything is running in 64-bit mode—even though it seems minor, sometimes a mix of 32-bit and 64-bit Java installations causes issues. A friend had this problem, and switching to 64-bit resolved it. Just a small tip from me.
Thanks [user_name]! I did have a God Mode folder—after deleting it (which is unfortunate since it's convenient for Windows configuration), [product_name] works perfectly now. Incredible!

Regarding the other suggestions: @HorGa: No, I haven't tried running it in compatibility mode. @peterakos: I actually have both 32-bit and 64-bit versions of Java installed (forgot to mention earlier).
You're welcome [user_name]. I agree, it is inconvenient to lose access to God Mode. It provides access to all Windows control panels from a single folder, which is very handy.

analysis.insight_summary: The user ran into an issue where [product_name] would close immediately upon launch, which was traced to a conflict with the Windows 'God Mode' folder. The discussion emphasizes how external system settings, such as Windows features and Java architecture, can affect software compatibility and operation. Troubleshooting steps included reinstalling, adjusting Java versions, and disabling security software, pointing to limited error reporting or diagnostic feedback for users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to start and run reliably on recommended system hardware and software without unexplained closures. They also want clear error messages or feedback if the application fails to launch.
